items: We're already using tools like Zapier. Isn't that enough?

Basic automation tools are great starting points, but they hit limits fast. Professional services firms have complex workflows that need sophisticated logic, error handling, and custom integrations. We build enterprise-grade systems that scale with your growth and handle the complexity basic tools can't.
How do I know this will work for our specific situation?

That's exactly why we start with a comprehensive audit. We don't propose solutions until we deeply understand your operations. Our discovery process ensures we're solving your actual problems, not selling pre-packaged products. You see the roadmap and expected results before you commit to implementation.
What if our team resists the change?

We've implemented automation across dozens of professional services firms. Change management is built into our methodology. We involve your team early, design solutions that make their jobs easier (not obsolete), and provide comprehensive training. When people see automation eliminating their most frustrating tasks, adoption happens naturally.
Isn't custom AI development expensive and time-consuming?

Traditional AI projects can be. Our approach is different. We use proven frameworks, pre-trained models, and rapid development techniques to deliver custom solutions in weeks, at a fraction of traditional costs. You get enterprise-level capabilities without enterprise-level budgets or timelines.
How quickly will we see ROI?

Most clients see measurable time savings within 30 days of deployment. Full ROI typically happens within 3–6 months, depending on scope. During discovery we calculate expected ROI based on your specific costs and opportunities, so you know exactly what to expect.
How much does this cost?

Pricing depends on scope: a single workflow automation is very different from a full operations overhaul. Most engagements are quoted after the discovery audit, once we know exactly what needs to be built. We'll always give you a clear number before any work begins, no surprise invoices.
Will automation replace our employees?

No. Our goal is to remove repetitive, low-value work so your team can focus on client relationships, strategy, and the parts of the job that actually need a human. Most clients use the freed-up time to take on more clients rather than reduce headcount.
Is our data secure during this process?

Yes. We follow least-privilege access practices, use secure authenticated connections for every integration, and never store more data than a workflow needs to function. Specific security requirements can be discussed and agreed upon before any access is granted.
Do you only work with large firms?
No. We work with firms of all sizes, from solo practitioners to multi-partner firms. The audit and roadmap scale to your size.
What happens after the automation is built?

No. Every project includes documentation and team training so you're never locked in. We also offer ongoing support and retainer options if you'd like us to monitor, maintain, and extend the system over time.
Can you work with our existing tech stack?
In almost every case we build on top of what you already use. Switching platforms is rarely necessary and adds cost and disruption without improving the outcome.
How is this different from hiring an in-house automation person?

An in-house hire is one person with one skill set, fully loaded cost included. We bring a full team's worth of automation, AI, and integration expertise on demand, without the overhead of a full-time salary, benefits, or ramp-up time.
